messages:
maria: heads-up — i'm opening a small terraform change to switch a couple of prod VPCs from per-vpc NATs -> transit-gateway egress attachment (we want consistent outbound ips). PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/452 :eyes:

maria: terraform plan looks clean but plan shows `aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation` +2 and a couple of route replacements. snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation" "egress-prop" {
  transit_gateway_route_table_id = aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table.egress.id
  transit_gateway_attachment_id = aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment.egress_attach.id
}
```

maria: main risk: two older VPCs have propagation disabled on their attachment RTs, so routes won't appear unless we enable it. also double-checking no overlapping custom routes.

nathan: can you paste the exact plan output for the prod VPCs? especially concerned about routes being replaced vs added.

maria: plan excerpt:
```
  # aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation.egress-prop[1] will be created
  + resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation" "egress-prop" {
      + id                              = (known after apply)
      + transit_gateway_attachment_id   = "tgw-attach-0a1b2c3d"
      + transit_gateway_route_table_id  = "tgw-rtb-0f1e2d3c"
    }
  # aws_route.egress_vpc_route will be replaced
  ~ resource "aws_route" "egress_vpc_route" {
      ~ gateway_id = "nat-0a1b2c3" -> ""
    }
```

alex: quick checks — confirm the VPC has an IGW route for local -> that's fine. Also ensure security group/stateful rules aren't assuming NAT IPs. any services pinned to old egress ips?

maria: good catch — two services (billing webhook consumer, analytics shipper) had IP allowlists. i've added a note in the PR to update the allowlist and a migration ticket to add the TGW egress elastic IPs / ALB ACL entries.

nathan: +1 on migration ticket. also prefer applying to one AZ/vpc as a canary then wait 30m for logs/5xx spike. please run `terraform apply -target=aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation.egress-prop` for canary.

maria: will do. scheduling canary in the 2h maintenance window. tagging infra-oncall. @sre-oncall please monitor tail of egress LB + 5xx alerts during canary. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sre-oncall: ack — i'll watch dashboards and set a 30m rollback timer. if >0.5% 5xx increase, i'll rollback and notify.

infra-bot: scheduled maintenance window active 2026-03-18T18:00Z -> 2026-03-18T20:00Z for infra:egress-migration (ticket RED-998).

maria: applied to staging; smoke looks good (no 5xx, traffic egressed through tgw egress). canary target: vpc-prod-1132 in us-west-2 in 15m.

infra-bot: starting `terraform apply -target=aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation.egress-prop` for pr/452 (plan id: plan-9843).

maria: applied to vpc-prod-1132 canary, waiting on metrics.

maria: canary check after 20m: no errors, egress IP switched, analytics shipper succeeded, billing webhook ok. rolling to remaining prod vpcs in batches of 2.

nathan: LGTM from infra side. once remaining batches pass, update runbook and close RED-998.

maria: noted — will update runbook with rollback steps (tf state target apply to re-enable NAT routes + remove propagation). thanks all :tada:
